title: The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three

result.label: The Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three
result.statement: Resolves the odd-primary Kervaire invariant problem at the prime three: exactly the standard classes with indices 0, 2, and 3 survive in the mod-three Adams spectral sequence, in stems 10, 106, and 322. Each surviving detection coset contains an element of exact additive order three.
